description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Cradle Clearcutter
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cradle Clearcutter
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater
